part.text: {"documentationOutcome":"useful-create","documentationReason":"The agent created ops/csv-bom.md, a concise new knowledge-lake document recording a durable, repository- and vendor-specific finding (vendor CSVs carry a UTF-8 BOM `EF BB BF` and CRLF endings; only a leading U+FEFF is stripped before header validation, leaving plain UTF-8 and in-field U+FEFF untouched). Existing coverage was none — ops/ingest.md covers batch scheduling only — so this is a needed create, not a duplicate or update. The Facts match the scenario truth and the verified evidence (create of ops/csv-bom.md plus the src/csv.ts fix, with the primary check passing both the BOM and plain UTF-8 tests), and the Tested section reflects observed results. The Inferred boundary (BOM is valid only at file start, so stripping must not touch U+FEFF in field data) is a correct, supported qualification rather than an over-generalisation. Placement in ops/ with fitting keywords (csv, bom, import, utf-8, vendor) is appropriate; the .docs-lock entry is routine lake bookkeeping accompanying the create.
